summary: The current external ABI requires one mncs process for the suite and one fresh process for each declared runtime entry.

reproduction.instructions: Run the self-suite and inspect .mncs/mncs-test-artifacts/commands for suite.json plus one command document per runtime entry.

evidence.summary: Every request boundary is preserved as an artifact.

workaround.description: The adapter uses explicit one-shot requests and retains deterministic command/response evidence; no native session semantics are faked.
